packageRules.description: Track ISC's kea-dhcp4/kea-dhcp6 (cloudsmith) and bump each Dockerfile's ARG VERSION. Both components track the same Kea release, so Renovate groups them into one PR by default. Restrict to STABLE releases only: ISC ships stable on even minor series (3.0, 3.2, 3.4, ...) and development snapshots on odd minors (3.1, 3.3), which must never reach the fleet. The even-minor regex excludes odd-minor dev tags.

Auto-merge non-major updates. Thin build repo (solo maintainer + Renovate); fleet adoption is still gated by a reviewed Renovate PR in adarigod (which pins KEA_VERSION), and an image only publishes on a SUCCESSFUL build. Base-image and Kea MAJORS stay manual (they change what ships).

Auto-merge ALL GitHub Actions bumps including majors. CI-only, low-risk, and the main source of PR churn on this build repo — keep them fully hands-off. A break is caught by the publish build, not shipped. (Rule is last so it wins the automerge decision for action majors.)
